name: CHEG 3120
title: Transport Phenomena I
description: Overall mass, energy, and momentum balances; fluid flow phenomena; theoretical and empirical relationships for design of incompressible fluid-flow systems. Conductive heat transfer; heat transfer coefficients and design of heat exchange systems. Radiation heat transfer, evaporation.
requirement_description: MATH 2110Q and 2410Q; CHEM 1128Q; CHEG 2103 and 2111; open only to School of Engineering students.
